value: The Lantern Accord’s trade fair at Lantern Hill draws traders from across the rim, though whispers suggest some merchants are less than eager to meet the Accord’s pricing standards. Gladwater’s jade sculpture has become a point of fascination among traders, though its origins remain unclear. The Reedmother’s Children report an unusually bountiful fishing season, with nets brimming and fish leaping into them with alarming ease. The Ninefingers Gang remains silent, their last known activity a botched attempt to raid Gladwater’s outer defenses.

The Ninefingers Gang remains silent, but their last failed raid on Gladwater has left the colony wary.
